title: Ai2 replaces GPU priority battles with budgets and fair-share scheduling
friendlyTitle: Ai2 uses clear budgets to share scarce GPUs
summary: Ai2 has replaced a priority-based scheduler for thousands of research GPUs with a hierarchy of time budgets, fair-share allocation and protected time slices. The institute says its previous system encouraged priority inflation, idle resource hoarding and costly negotiations over jobs that could not be interrupted.
friendlySummary: Ai2 stopped letting every research job claim high priority. Teams now receive a share of GPU time, while the scheduler uses spare capacity where it is needed.
whyItMatters: Scarce AI compute is as much a governance problem as a technical one. Allocating time according to strategy, then letting a scheduler share unused capacity, gives teams clearer expectations and reduces incentives to game priority labels—a pattern that also applies to internal model quotas and agent budgets.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Clear budgets can be fairer and easier to manage than constant priority arguments. The same idea can help companies share AI spending across teams.
